experiments.name: Run 1: KuBERT's default tokenizer settings (accent stripping on)
experiments.note: Accent stripping removed the hamza from ئ, so 8.1% of tokens became [UNK]. Scored below the baseline.

experiments.name: Run 2: accent stripping off, ى/ھ normalised (final model)
experiments.note: Unknown tokens fell to 4.6%, mostly punctuation and digits that KuBERT's vocabulary lacks.
